Class H3VectorLayerRenderer

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.renderers.H3VectorLayerRenderer
public class H3VectorLayerRenderer extends Object
Renders vector GIS overlays, topographic contours, directional flux vector fields, mineral/aquifer resource badges, coordinate HUD badges, and analytical distribution legends.

Extracted from H3MapCanvas to fulfill SRP and decouple spatial vector geometries from raw raster canvas pixel pipelines.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
